methods.name: Comparative assessment of DCNN models (VGG, ResNet, DenseNet, U-Net)
methods.summary: The authors conducted a comparative performance assessment of several existing deep learning architectures (VGG16, VGG19, ResNet50, ResNet101, DenseNet120, DenseNet201, UNet-, UNet+, and ResUNet) for landslide detection, testing them with different sample sizes (100, 1000, and 10,000) to provide clues for model selection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and remote sensing imagery are referenced and linked, but the custom code used for the comparative assessment of DCNN models is not provided or linked.
